trust_decision.summary: Whether caller-supplied record fields may be used as property names on the two shared lookup maps without being able to resolve inherited properties: convert() reads id/parent from input at index.js:50-51 and indexes plain `{}` maps at index.js:52,57,62,68-70, so `parent === '__proto__'` resolves temp[parent] to Object.prototype and initPush writes onto it; the fix rules that only own keys may resolve, via Object.create(null) at index.js:45-46.

landing_point.why: The summary names `__proto__` parent/id keys used as object keys; the only plain-object maps in the conversion are `temp` and `pendingChildOf`, and `temp` is what the input `parent` value indexes at index.js:57 before initPush writes to the resolved object.

fix_sites.entry_point: FlatToNested.prototype.convert(flat) -- the package's only public API method (module main is index.js, package.json:21; usage in README.md:23)
fix_sites.module_kind: library main module, single-file CommonJS IIFE export

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site and no O8 route exists: the only keyed operations the hunk does not change are `delete flatEl[this.config.parent]` (index.js:65) and `nested[this.config.children] = roots` (index.js:77), both keyed by caller config rather than by input data, and neither reaches Object.prototype.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: convert() returns the caller's own record objects by reference (a single root is returned as-is, and children are the input records themselves) and, by default, deletes the parent field from those input records in place (options default {deleteParent: true}). A fix that sanitises by cloning records, or that drops/renames any record whose id or parent equals an inherited name, breaks this aliasing/mutation contract and also breaks legitimate nesting of a record whose id really is `__proto__` (the fix's own third test asserts that case still nests).

O6_input_shapes: parent value is the string '__proto__' (inherited accessor hit on temp) -- the direct/polluting shape
id value is the string '__proto__' (record stored under an inherited key on temp)
other inherited Object.prototype names used as id/parent values: 'constructor', 'prototype', 'toString', 'valueOf', 'hasOwnProperty' (null-proto maps cover these; the tests only name '__proto__')

the same maps are used for every property-name configuration, since id/parent/children names are caller-configurable (constructor defaults at index.js:30-32; custom-config tests at test/test.js:108-115)
ordering shapes: parent already seen (temp hit, index.js:57-59) versus parent not yet seen (pendingChildOf path, index.js:62 and index.js:68-71)
scalar non-string ids/parents (numbers), 0/1/many roots, and the parent record arriving after its child

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A single plain-object grouping map keyed by input data (e.g. an option that returns roots grouped as {rootId: subtree} in the multi-root branch) instead of the current array `children: roots`.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The multi-root branch already builds a wrapper object and assigns under a config key; a maintainer adding `groupRoots`/`keyByRootId` would naturally reach for `nested[rootId] = subtree` with a plain `{}`, reintroducing exactly the input-value-as-property-name sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An incremental/upsert path (e.g. `append(records)` or `convertInto(existing, flat)`) reusing the same `temp[id]` style id-keyed memo, so input ids index a plain object in another function.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The id-keyed `temp` map is the package's only indexing structure; reusing it for incremental conversion is a short, obvious extension, and it would need the same null-prototype treatment to stay safe.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second consumer of initPush/multiInitPush that passes an input-derived name as the `arrayName` argument (line 62 already passes the input `parent` value there), or a config merge helper that copies caller-supplied config keys onto an object.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: initPush's `obj[arrayName] === undefined` guard is not a protection when arrayName names an inherited member; a maintainer adding another grouping call site would copy line 62's pattern and inherit the same defect.

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321 / CWE-915) via input-controlled property names on plain-object lookup maps

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + npm; mocha + chai for tests; jshint/eslint/dtslint for lint; browserify + uglify for the optional dist bundle (not required for tests)
O10_build.project_tests: test/test.js (mocha, 243 lines at the pinned commit): default configuration, custom configuration (id/parent/children renamed) and deleteParent:false; no prototype-pollution, __proto__ or inherited-name test exists at the pinned commit (grep for pollut|__proto__|constructor finds only types/index.d.ts:13 and README.md:46).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Blacklist the literal '__proto__' (skip or rename such records, or add an id !== '__proto__' test), which misses 'constructor'/'prototype' and the config-renamed key route and breaks legitimate nesting under a record whose id is '__proto__'.

out_of_scope_notes: index.js:77 `nested[this.config.children] = roots` and index.js:65 `delete flatEl[this.config.parent]` use caller-config keys rather than input data and do not reach Object.prototype, so they are not treated as advisory routes.
